public_rationale: Cognition's March 12, 2024 announcement describes Devin accepting feedback and discussing design choices, but the supplied text contains no complete exchange demonstrating requirements clarification and implementation discussion [e1]. The study submitted July 14, 2023 evaluates generated requirements, a narrower task outside the January 1–April 15, 2024 assessment period [e2]. These items establish neither successful performance of the full collaborative task during that period nor a general inability to perform it [e1, e2].
limitations: The vendor description does not verify the capability through an inspectable interaction [e1].
The earlier requirements study does not test the full collaborative task during the assessment period [e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI cannot collaboratively discuss project requirements and implementation, an essential software engineering task.

statement.excerpt: First, AI can’t handle one of the most essential tasks of software engineering, which is collaboratively discussing the requirements of a project and how to implement the technology.

from_speaker: collaboratively discussing the requirements of a project
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that then-current AI could not substantively exchange questions, clarify software requirements, and discuss implementation choices with a person.
Successful collaboration need not mean autonomous delivery or flawless performance.
Although the surrounding discussion concerns Devin, the sentence expressly refers to AI generally.
No reporting period is specified. I use 2024 through publication as the current-state observation window; earlier experiments provide context.
criteria.support_condition: Direct evaluations of then-current systems show that they could not conduct substantive, responsive discussions covering project requirements and implementation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented interaction with a then-current system shows substantive clarification of software requirements and discussion of implementation choices with a person.

evidence.explanation: Cognition expressly described interactive design work. This challenges the categorical wording, but the retrieved text does not supply a complete exchange demonstrating requirements clarification and implementation discussion.
The researchers evaluated AI-generated requirements against expert responses. This is relevant earlier evidence of assistance, but neither its period nor its task directly matches the full claim.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A complete human–AI exchange from January 1–April 15, 2024 showing substantive requirements clarification and implementation discussion would contradict the claim. Direct evaluations of then-current systems establishing the claimed general inability would support it.
